Persist scheduled GitHub authorization schema v3

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-7
  description: |-
    Extend the deployed v3 snapshot so scheduled GitHub jobs store an explicit account, tagged repository or organization scope, and read/write access. Keep v1/v2 payloads byte-compatible as exact repositories, reject auto and mixed organization ceilings, and require a generation-checked update before any repository job can widen to organization scope.
